  • Show All
  • August 19th - Entropiq enter Counter-Strike: Global Offensive by signing the roster of Projekt F consisting of leckr, capseN, AJTT, daxen, HONES, and forji as coach. [1]
  • January 19th - Entropiq replace daxen with MoriiSko. [2][3]
  • February 5th - Entropiq replace forji with d0di. [4]
  • May 10th - Entropiq transfer their Czech roster to Entropiq Prague, a newly-formed division. They sign the roster of EPG Family, consisting of El1an, Lack1, NickelBack, Krad, Forester, and hooch, the head coach. Additionally, XomA and Dart are signed as assistant coach and manager, respectively. [5][6]
  • June 8th - Entropiq bench Lack1 and acquire mir from Team Spirit as his replacement. [7]
  • July 11th - Entropiq release Lack1. [8]
  • September 15th - Entropiq transfer-list El1an by mutual agreement. [9]
  • October 13th - Entropiq transfer-list their lineup, however they will continue to actively compete until their contracts expire. [10]
  • November 12th - Entropiq release NickelBack, mir, Krad, El1an, and XomA. [11]
  • January 10th - Entropiq part ways with hooch. [12]
  • February 1st - Entropiq reveal their new roster consisting of AJTT, MoriiSko, Rutk0, red, snatchie and Loord, with the latter joining as coach. [13]
  • February 10th - Forester is acquired by 1win. [14]
  • April 21st - Entropiq bench MoriiSko and part ways with Rutk0. [15]
  • April 28th - Entropiq sign PlesseN and ritchiEE. [16]
  • June 1st - Entropiq release MoriiSko. [17]
  • June 19th - Entropiq bench and transfer-list their roster. [18]
  • June 30th - Entropiq release Loord upon the expiration of his contract. [19]
  • July 5th - Entropiq acquire forsyy from SINNERS Esports. [20]
  • July 28th - Entropiq sign tiziaN, c0llins, Oxygen, Marix and enkay J, the latter as coach. [21]
  • August 21st - Entropiq release AJTT, red and snatchie upon the expiration of their contracts. [22][23][24]
  • September 1st - Entropiq part ways with ritchiEE. [25]
  • September 28th - PlesseN is acquired by Alliance. [26]
  • December 15th - forsyy is acquired by Dynamo Eclot. [27]
  • December 27th - Entropiq sign mwlky. [28]
  • March 31st - Entropiq bench c0llins, Oxygen and mwlky. [29]
  • April 24th - c0llins is acquired by iNation. [30]
  • May 1st - Entropiq acquire Buzz and regali from Astralis and OG, respectively, and sign FASHR. [31]
  • May 20th - Oxygen is acquired by 500. [32]
  • June 21st - Entropiq bench their roster. [33]
  • July 1st - Entropiq release mwlky upon the expiration of his contract. [34]
  • August 19th - Marix is acquired by FAVBET Team. [35]
  • September 5th - Entropiq release tiziaN upon the expiration of his contract. [36]
  • September 9th - enkay J is aquired by ENCE. [37]
  • September 23rd - Buzz is acquired by OG. [38]
  • October 1st - Entropiq release regali upon the expiration of his contract. [39]
  • October 2nd - Entropiq release FASHR upon the expiration of his contract. [40]
